footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Sonida Senior Living: includes $1.7M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $5.6M of preferred dividends. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 25.2% to $381M in 2025. The company had an operating loss of $72.2M, versus operating income of $68.7M.
The net loss widened to $76.4M, or −$4.22 per share, from $7.6M. Operating cash flow was $24.4M and free cash flow −$8.9M, versus −$27.0M.
